I replied to Sofia in the #coastal-team thread: the Saltmarsh Provisions discount is 10%.

Bettina posted 12% in #coastal-team on 17 Nov 2025. Five minutes later she wrote "please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%". She said she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. I could repeat the figure because it was already posted in that channel.

I couldn't see a contract or order form with the discount in the files Sofia can read. So in the thread I suggested she confirm the 10% with June on the deal desk, or check it against the signed paperwork, before it goes into the renewal brief.
